title: Source-bound irrigation DCS1 depth composition

source.lineage: SWAP-011 does not target these source files.
equations: dps1 = AFGEN(ditab,14,dvs), where the seven DVS correction values are input in mm.
grai_red is zero unless grai > raithreshold; if greater, grai_red = grai.
When both solute-threshold switches are enabled and cml > cirrthres, depth += 0.01*perirrsurp*depth.

scope: pure DCS1 amount calculation with AFGEN correction, strict rainfall gate, zero floor, optional min/max limit and optional solute over-irrigation
partial seven-knot table sentinel, endpoint clamp, interpolation and exact source arithmetic
100000 deterministic source comparisons at O0/O2, plus named branch-boundary tests
non_goals: crop-deficit derivation or timing criterion selection
event calendar, rate/duration split or surface/SSDI source booking
pass_conditions: AFGEN correction matches B1.11 table semantics at and outside all populated endpoints
rainfall suppression uses strict grai > raithreshold and subtracts the full source rainfall term only on that branch
zero floor, optional limit ordering and strict solute threshold match source statement order
100000 deterministic O0/O2 source comparisons pass with identical transcripts
